name: parks-avy-fx
description: Parks Canada Visitor Safety avalanche forecast workbench (AVID replacement)

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.jsx --bundle --minify --jsx=automatic --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/app.js --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" && cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css && cp index.html dist/index.html && cp node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.js node_modules/maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css dist/
scripts.predev: mkdir -p dist && cp src/styles.css dist/styles.css && cp index.html dist/index.html
